label: Yellow or discolored leaves or needles
help_text: Leaves or needles turning yellow, pale, or patchy

label: Shriveled or wrinkled leaves
help_text: Leaves look deflated, thin, or wrinkled

label: Leaves pointing down or lying flat
help_text: Leaves tip downward or flatten out instead of staying upright

label: Leaves folding inward
help_text: Leaves curl or close up toward the center

label: Brown tips or edges
help_text: Dry, crispy brown ends or edges on leaves or needles

label: Wilting or drooping
help_text: Leaves or stems sagging or limp

label: Spots or white coating on leaves
help_text: Dots, patches, or a white powdery film on the leaf surface

label: Not flowered
help_text: A plant that normally flowers is not producing blooms
